name: Anand Quiz
author: Anand Sites

sections.description:
Anand Quiz is a user-friendly quiz builder designed to help you create unlimited quizzes and exams for your WordPress site.

Built with performance in mind, Anand Quiz uses a clean, modern interface that fits seamlessly into the WordPress admin. Whether you are an educator, a blogger, or a business owner, Anand Quiz makes it easy to engage your audience.

Key Features

  • Quiz Builder: Easily add and edit questions and options.
  • Unlimited Quizzes: Create as many quizzes as you need.
  • Smart Result: Auto-calculates results and shows a detailed review at the end.
  • Import & Export: Move quizzes between sites easily using JSON.
  • Shortcode System: Embed quizzes anywhere using simple shortcodes (e.g., [anand_quiz id="5"]).
  • Responsive Design: Looks great on mobiles, tablets, and desktops.
  • Clean Uninstall: Optional “Delete Data on Uninstall” feature to keep your database clean.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/anand-quiz directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the “Anand Quiz” menu to create your first quiz.
  4. Copy the shortcode from the quiz list and paste it into any Post or Page.
sections.faq:
How do I display a quiz?

Once you create and save a quiz, you will see a “Shortcode” column in the main list. Copy that code (e.g., [anand_quiz id="5"]) and paste it into any page, post, or widget.

How do I backup my quizzes?

Go to Anand Quiz > Settings. In the “Export” tab, click “Export to JSON” to download a full backup of your quizzes. You can import this file into any other site using Anand Quiz.
